subject: Mobile Development
title: BlackBerry: From Addiction to Irrelevance
description: Learn BlackBerry: From Addiction to Irrelevance in one minute.

hook.text: In 2009, BlackBerry had 20% of the global smartphone market. By 2016, it had 0%.

buildup.text: BlackBerry's CEO dismissed the iPhone: 'It's not a good email machine.'

discovery.text: When BlackBerry finally made a touchscreen phone, the Storm, it was a disaster.

twist.text: BlackBerry's strength — security and keyboards — became irrelevant in the app economy.

climax.text: BlackBerry stopped making phones in 2016 and pivoted to enterprise security software.

punchline.text: The email phone couldn't survive the app age.

quiz.question: What was BlackBerry's failed touchscreen phone called?
